"Entered according to act of Congress by C.K. Stone in the year 1863 in the Clerk's Office of the District Court of the Eastern District of Pennsylvania." Includes business directory, insets of Cannonsburg, Rawson, Williamstown, Benton, Houcktown or North Liberty, Arllington, Mt. Blanchard, West Indepedence, McComb, Vanlue, Arcadia, Van Buren, Findlay, and views of commercial properties.
